text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Japanese Derby drawing near, a press conference is held at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's here that Special Week vows to win and keep her promise to her moms…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As well as to give me the title of Derby trainer.
